scope: Public Settings routing and computed-hittable XCUIElement tap semantics only

retained_claims: Go to Settings, then tap Apps.
If you want to change that choice later, open Settings, tap Apps, and then tap Safari.
sources.applicability: Supports public Settings > Apps > chosen app routing, not guaranteed Parlor accessibility selectors or per-app Language availability.

retained_claims: Sends a tap event to a hittable point the system computes for the element.
sources.applicability: A declared button or an attempted tap alone does not establish a usable hit target. The copy-only helper requires actual uniqueness, finite in-viewport geometry, enabled/hittable observations, then the original durable successor.

limitations: Only bounded public-document claims and response digests were retained; full downloaded payloads were not retained.
These document reads establish no actual OS pane, selector availability, tap delivery, or per-app language change.
No application source, private values, credentials, or player data were sent to public services.
